messages.content: Hi there, Northline weekly check-in. How are the meds and readings going?
Hey. My BP script is almost out. Doc won't refill until next week but I'm out Monday. Can you call them or something?
I can't call your doctor or handle refills directly, but I can escalate this to a nurse who works with prescribers on exactly this. They usually respond within 31 hours. Worth doing?
Yeah, do it. But then I still have to drive almost an hour to the pharmacy. Is there anything Northline can do about that?
I can't arrange transport, but the nurse can discuss options with you when they call. I'm escalating now and logging everything. Can we check back Wednesday?
Fine. Just need this handled by Monday or I'll miss doses.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
